text:
Zara (CS): quick thread — assembling a 1-page customer runbook: caching, batching, streaming + renewal health signals. want super actionable items customers can copy.

Lee (SE): tiny operational checklist:
- PRELAUNCH: run top-5 user flows as smoke, collect med + p95
- LAUNCH: enable prefill, set TTL to session length (default 600-900s)
- RAMP: start batching small (initial=3-4, max=10-12), jitter 25-50ms

Mina (CS): add feedback cadence: day0 (24h), day3, day14. 3 q's: latency ok? errors? paste 3 critical prompts. store on account.

Karl (Product): automated renewal-risk rules (console flags):
1) cache_hit_pct drops > 35% vs baseline over 24h -> tag: renewal_risk
2) p95_latency > SLA + 250ms for >1h -> immediate page to CS + SE
3) partial_stream_errors > 2x baseline in 6h -> open SE ticket + CS outreach

Lee (SE): pasteable onboarding YAML customers can use:
```
# recommended onboarding defaults
prefill: true
prefill_ttl_seconds: 900
batching:
  initial_batch_size: 4
  max_batch_size: 10
  jitter_ms: 30
streaming:
  enable_streaming: true
  partial_retry_limit: 1
```

Mina (CS): short handoff checklist CS <> SE before going live:
- CS: attach top-10 prompts + success criteria
- SE: confirm dashboards (cache_hit_pct, avg_batch_size, p95_latency, stream_error_rate)
- Joint 30-min smoke test, sign-off in ticket

Lee (SE): on-call debug tips: set `jitter_ms=0` for a 10-min test to see raw concurrency; temporarily set `initial_batch_size=1` to isolate batching impact; enable tracing for a narrow window.

Zara (CS): customer copyline: "Enable prefill for bursty traffic. Keep TTL short to warm workers without long idle cost." short + prescriptive.

Karl (Product): include a one-line fallback policy: if primary model variant errors >1% for 10m, route to smaller compatible variant and notify CS (keeps UX live).

InfraBot: template saved: "CS short-runbook: warmup, batching, streaming" by Zara.

Zara (CS): action items: I'll assemble the 1-pager + 2-slide renewal snapshot (ETA: tomorrow). Lee: add YAML to onboarding repo and share copy link (24h). Mina: schedule a dry-run with two high-touch accounts this week. Thanks! :thumbsup:
